description: Snapshot of Claude Code upstream surface area as known to the cc-settings zod schemas. Updated by hand via the /cc sync skill; bun run upstream:scan reports drift but never writes. See docs/migration-coexistence.md.
source: manual sync via the /cc sync skill (the automated upstream-sync bot was retired June 2026).
notes: knownSettingsKeys mirrors the top-level keys enumerated in src/schemas/settings.ts. Order is alphabetical so the scanner's diffs stay stable.

knownEnvVars is reference-only — bun run upstream:scan does NOT diff it. There is no local Claude-Code-itself env var source in this codebase to diff against (these are upstream CC process env vars, not application env vars set via settings.json's `env` key, which IS schema-backed). Updated by hand via the /cc sync skill when the changelog mentions a new one.

knownBuiltinTools is reference-only — bun run upstream:scan does NOT diff it. src/schemas/permissions.ts intentionally treats `Tool(pattern)` permission rules as an opaque string (schema's job is to catch typos in keys, not to enumerate every tool name), so there is no local schema enum to diff against. Refreshed 2026-07-06 with the current live tool list (previously missing Artifact, WebFetch, WebSearch, Monitor, the Task* family, SendMessage, Workflow, Enter/ExitPlanMode, Enter/ExitWorktree, LSP, AskUserQuestion, PushNotification). Updated by hand via the /cc sync skill.

knownHookTypes is diffed by bun run upstream:scan against the Hook discriminated union's `type` literals in src/schemas/hooks.ts (CommandHook/HttpHook/PromptHook/AgentHook/McpToolHook). Includes `mcp_tool` (added 2.1.118) for hooks that invoke MCP tools directly.
knownPermissionModes is diffed by bun run upstream:scan against the PermissionMode enum in src/schemas/permissions.ts (agent.ts's AgentPermissionMode re-exports the same enum).

knownMcpTransports is diffed by bun run upstream:scan against the `type` literals on McpStdioServer/McpHttpServer/McpSseServer in src/schemas/mcp.ts. Added "sse" (previously missing) — used by local desktop MCPs (e.g. Figma at http://127.0.0.1:3845/sse) that stream events instead of request/response.

knownAgentIsolation / knownAgentMemory are diffed by bun run upstream:scan against the AgentIsolation/AgentMemory enums in src/schemas/agent.ts. Widened 2026-07-06 (issue #82/#104) to include "remote" isolation and "user"/"local" memory scopes, which were real documented values previously rejected by the schema.
v2.1.139 added two hook fields (not enumerated here, see src/schemas/hooks.ts): `args: string[]` on command hooks (exec form, no shell) and `continueOnBlock: boolean` on PostToolUse hooks.
v2.1.143 added `worktree.bgIsolation: "none"` to disable background-session worktree isolation — see src/schemas/settings.ts.

v2.1.163 added two managed settings keys: requiredMinimumVersion/requiredMaximumVersion (version-range gate, distinct from the older minimumVersion). It also let Stop/SubagentStop hooks return hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext (runtime output, not a config field — see docs/hooks-reference.md).

v2.1.166 added the fallbackModel settings key (string | string[]; up to three fallback models tried in order when the primary is overloaded/unavailable) — see src/schemas/settings.ts. 2.1.167/2.1.168 were bug-fixes-only.

v2.1.169 added the disableBundledSkills settings key (hide Anthropic's bundled skills/workflows/built-in slash commands from the model) plus three env vars: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS (env counterpart), CLAUDE_CODE_SAFE_MODE (counterpart of the new --safe-mode troubleshooting flag), and API_FORCE_IDLE_TIMEOUT (=0 opts out of the restored 5-min Vertex/Foundry idle-stream timeout). The rest of 2.1.169 was bug-fixes and runtime/UI tweaks (managed-MCP reconnect enforcement, /cd command, history-row navigation, perf).

v2.1.195 added the CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS env var (disable mouse click/drag/hover in fullscreen mode while keeping wheel scroll) — a CC-itself TUI toggle, manifest-tracked only. It also fixed hook matchers with hyphenated identifiers (e.g. code-reviewer, mcp__brave-search) accidentally substring-matching — they now exact-match; use a `__.*` suffix to match all tools from a hyphenated MCP server. Verified-safe for cc-settings: every hook matcher in config/40-hooks.json is a non-hyphenated builtin tool name (Bash, Edit, Write|Edit, Edit|Write|MultiEdit). v2.1.194 shipped with no changelog entries (skipped). The rest of 2.1.195 was voice-dictation, plugin-loader, and background-task/remote-session bug fixes with no config surface.

v2.1.203/2.1.204 were bug-fixes-only (background-agent/daemon reliability, TUI polish, headless SessionStart hook streaming) — no new config surface. The 2.1.203 notes surfaced CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE (full mouse-capture opt-out, companion to CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS), which we had never tracked; added to knownEnvVars. Also added advisorModel to knownSettingsKeys — it entered src/schemas/settings.ts in PR #126 (upstream 2.1.98) but the manifest was never updated, so the scanner flagged it every run.

v2.1.216/2.1.217: added sandbox.filesystem.disabled (skip FS isolation, keep network egress control) and emojiCompletionEnabled to src/schemas/settings.ts. Three env vars tracked: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS (concurrent-subagent cap, default 20), CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH (subagents no longer spawn nested subagents by default; cc-settings shipped "2" in config/10-core.json so maestro/deslopper kept their fan-out — pin removed in v13.2.1 once upstream's own default rose to 3 in v2.1.219, turning the pin into a restriction rather than a loosener), FORCE_HYPERLINK (=0 opts out of forced footer hyperlinks over ssh/tmux). The rest of both releases was bug fixes and upstream UX with no config surface.

v2.1.218–2.1.220 sync. Adopted three surfaces: sandbox.network.strictAllowlist (2.1.219 — deny non-allowlisted hosts outright instead of prompting), the DirectoryAdded hook event (2.1.219 — fires after /add-dir or the SDK register_repo_root adds a working dir mid-session; knownHookEvents IS scanner-diffed, so this was a real gap), and the workflowSizeGuideline settings key (2.1.219 — advisory dynamic-workflow agent ceiling, upstream default "medium"/under 15 agents). workflowSizeGuideline is typed z.string() not an enum: the changelog names the default but never enumerates accepted values, and a closed set would reject a real one. Opus 5 becoming the default Opus model was a no-op — config/10-core.json already pinned claude-opus-5. Behavior changes documented but requiring no schema work: skills with context: fork now run in the background by default (2.1.218 — affects most of the cc-settings skill library), subagent nesting depth default raised 1 → 3 (2.1.219), and /code-review now runs as a background subagent (2.1.218). The rest of the three releases was TUI, vim, screen-reader, Windows-path, Bedrock, and gateway fixes with no cc-settings surface.

v2.1.221–2.1.223 sync. sandbox.credentials gained a `mask` mode (env vars 2.1.199, files 2.1.221) alongside `deny`, with extract/injectHosts/onExtractNoMatch/maskDuplicates — see src/schemas/settings.ts. The nested sandbox objects (network, filesystem, credentials) were switched from strict to loose after allowedDomains, tlsTerminate, allowManagedDomainsOnly, and allowPlaintextInject were found unmodelled and silently stripped on parse. Three env vars tracked: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_UNKNOWN_MODEL_WINDOW_ENFORCEMENT, CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN. Behavior changes documented but requiring no schema work: /review became an alias of /code-review in 2.1.223, and /code-review with no level now reuses the last level typed. blockedMarketplaces/strictKnownMarketplaces entries now accept "owner/*" wildcards. ultraplan was removed upstream in 2.1.222 with zero cc-settings references.

v2.1.224–2.1.226 sync. Two feature areas, both under-described by the changelog. (1) Cross-session messaging (2.1.224, macOS/Linux only, unavailable on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry): the changelog called it "cross-session SendMessage" and named no config, but it ships three settings keys — crossSessionInbound (accept|hold|refuse; UNSET IS NOT accept, Claude Code decides per message from both sessions' permission modes, and a "refuse" in project/local settings outranks every other scope), isolatePeerMachines (approval gate before a message leaves the machine; true from any scope wins), and dialogExpiry (60s|5m|10m|never, default 5m — a duration enum, not a number). Also added: the CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET env var (each session's inbox socket, exported to hooks before SessionStart runs) and ListAgents to knownBuiltinTools. sandbox.network.allowUnixSockets/allowAllUnixSockets were modelled at the same time — they predate the window but gate whether a sandboxed Bash command can reach that socket. (2) sandbox.credentials JWT masking + AWS SigV4 re-signing: decode: "jwt" and maskClaims on both file and env-var entries (synthetic JWT instead of an opaque sentinel so token parsers still work; BOTH fail open — a value that does not verify as a JWT is left unprotected with only a console warning), plus credentials.awsPairs and credentials.sigv4 (streaming/presigned/sigv4a, each deny|passthrough, all defaulting to deny). These four were already present in the 2.1.223 binary — 2.1.224 added validation and diagnostics, not the surface — so this closed a pre-existing gap the changelog surfaced rather than new drift; nothing had been silently stripped, since the nested sandbox objects went loose in the previous sync. Skipped: claude self-hosted-runner and its ~30 CLAUDE_RUNNER_* env vars (Team/Enterprise; injected BY the runner, not user-set), the archive plugin source (lives in known_marketplaces.json — cc-settings models marketplace IDs only, no plugin-source schema exists to extend), the gateway spend-limit message, the claude agents workspace-trust prompt, and the removed 200-subagent lifetime spawn cap (behavior only). 2.1.226 was bug-fixes-only. KNOWN GAP surfaced by this sync: the binary's settings enumeration carries ~70 top-level keys knownSettingsKeys does not (theme, verbose, autoCompactEnabled, askUserQuestionTimeout, daemonColdStart, totalTokensReminder*, ssh*, …). Nearly all long predate this window, so they were left alone rather than folded into a version-sync diff — they need their own reconciliation pass.

v2.1.229–2.1.234 sync (2.1.230 was never published — the upstream changelog jumps 2.1.229 → 2.1.231). Adopted: sandbox.ripgrep (2.1.232 — third sandbox binary override next to bwrapPath/socatPath; honored only from user/managed/--settings, project settings ignored, managed overrides of all three now require approval), and the marketplace trio extraKnownMarketplaces (pre-existing, previously unmodelled) plus its 2.1.232 aliases additionalMarketplaces/allowedMarketplaces (≡ strictKnownMarketplaces). Seven env vars tracked: CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT and CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS (2.1.233), CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME and CLAUDE_CODE_GOAL_CHECKIN_MINUTES (2.1.234), CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_PREFIX_STAGGER_MS and CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER (2.1.229), and CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS (2.1.233 — restores TodoWrite/Task* on Opus 4.8+, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, Mythos 5, where they were removed). cc-settings' response to that removal was to strip the tools from implementer/deslopper/maestro frontmatter rather than set the env var — following the upstream direction. Behavior changes documented but needing no schema work: subagent forking default-on and non-teammate spawns backgrounded by default (2.1.232), SendMessage bare-name delivery + @-mention of sessions + unique session names (2.1.232), /code-review backgrounded at every effort level (2.1.232), /config rows for dialogExpiry and crossSessionInbound (already modelled since 2.1.224). Skipped: all GitLab integration (token redaction, glab protection, marketplaces, MR badges — native, no config surface), gateway/enterprise surfaces (forward_user_identity, desktop overlay validation), plugin marketplace command sources (no plugin-source schema here, same call as the 2.1.224 sync), the selection:clear keybinding, and the usage-limit auto-continue toggle (settings key unnamed upstream; loose root tolerates it).
